metadata.query: What happened on the Trail of Tears?

final_answer: The Trail of Tears was a series of forced marches in which the United States government forcibly relocated Native American tribes, most notably the Cherokee Nation, from their ancestral homelands in the Southeastern United States to Indian Territory (present-day Oklahoma) between 1838 and 1839. The journey, known as the Trail of Tears, resulted in the deaths of thousands of Native Americans due to disease, starvation, and exposure to harsh weather conditions. [Source: Encyclopedia Britannica]
